remediation.fix: lib/security/seed-guard.ts aborts seed when NODE_ENV=production; seed never resets or hardcodes the staff password; random one-time password printed on first seed

edge JWT callback ignores client update() payloads; node auth re-derives kobaId/accountType/kobaIdRevealed from getAccountSnapshot (DB) on the update trigger
credentials authorize throttled per IP (20/15min) and per email (10/15min) before any DB read; throttled attempts indistinguishable from bad credentials
remediation.residualRisk: per-process limiter without Upstash (KOBA-SEC-009 staging condition)

remediation.fix: magic-byte validation for artifacts (zip/gzip/tar signatures; PE/ELF/Mach-O rejected; text must be NUL-free); signed downloads forced to Content-Disposition attachment + octet-stream; quarantine unchanged
remediation.residualRisk: no real malware scanner; archive contents not inspected
